schedule.requirements: Bring a packed lunch and wear appropriate clothing for outdoor work. Shorts, vests or skirts are not allowed. Tools will be provided. Break times will be scheduled during the session.
schedule.warning: If you do not wear the right clothes or do not bring your packed lunch, you might be sent back home and your hours will not be credited.
